s8.bic_rule: Fine training null NLL minus selected attenuation NLL > (3/2)*log(Ntrain); otherwise return the exact fitted null and zero held-out contrast.
s8.mcse_definition: Sample standard deviation with denominator N-1 divided by sqrt(N), including all exact floor-return zeros.

rejected_review_arithmetic.reason: Nine positive gains, three negative gains and eight exact zeros imply median zero; direct ddof=1 sample calculation gives the recorded MCSE.

comparator.win_definition: Strictly positive held-out saved-procedure contrast against the separately training-fitted a-only or (a,n) null. Both columns use all twenty histories; original inhibition gates and states are unchanged.
